snippet.title: Smile More - Official Trailer | Free Indie Horror Game 2026
snippet.description:
A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace! :)

See SMILE MORE on Steam for FREE ►► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4467540/Smile_More/

-

Pixel Poxet is a small indie studio founded by a couple of friends with a passion for creating engaging games across any genre. From cozy to romance to horror, we aim to craft the best experiences we can and have fun doing it!

❤︎ If you'd like to support our endeavors, check out the links below ❤︎
